description: Search for code across repositories in a project

filters.description: Optional filters to narrow search results

CodeElement.description: Filter by code element types (function, class, etc.)

includeContent.description: Whether to include full file content in results (default: true)

includeSnippet.description: Whether to include code snippets in results (default: true)

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project to search in (Default: no default project). If not provided, the default project will be used.

skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

top.description: Number of results to return (default: 100, max: 1000)

name: search_code
